name: Market-based mechanization outsourcing (tractor, combine, thresher services)
organization: Private service providers and machinery dealers (no central programme)
farmers: Not quantified nationally; tractor plowing +43 pp and combine harvesting +41 pp over ~10 years (S255)
area: Majority of rice area for land preparation (S162)
outcomes: Labour savings, timeliness and reduced harvest losses (S162); Net income +30-50% for mechanized vs traditional harvest/post-harvest in a Delta field experiment (S119); Combine adoption not associated with lower labour costs or higher paddy margins; benefit is released family labour for non-farm work (S263); Combine use 12 pp lower in 2023 than 2020 (S252)
barriers: Fuel cost and availability; Conflict restricting service provider movement; Rising service fees (+55% plowing, S302)
persistence: Persisted without subsidy for a decade; eroding since 2021

name: CORIGAP best management practices (drum seeders, laser land levelling, nutrient/water/post-harvest BMPs)
farmers: 200 farmers in the evaluation panel (S186); >600,000 farmers reached across six countries incl. Myanmar (S084, not Myanmar-specific)
outcomes: Adopters and non-adopters both experienced substantial positive changes 2012-2017; farmer-group effect on yields mediated (S186)
barriers: Not independently verified for Myanmar beyond the Bago panel

name: Rice Crop Manager (site-specific nutrient advice) - Myanmar version
outcomes: Prototype developed and shared with DoA; user interface revised after focus groups (S112); Comparable tool raised yields 17-19% in Odisha, India on-farm trials (S267)
barriers: No evidence of deployment after 2019; Extension disruption after 2021 (S200)
persistence: Not deployed (Not independently verified beyond 2019 record)

name: Digital climate advisory services (Village Link Htwet Toe app)
date: Platform active since 2018; rice pilot 2023; scaled 2025
organization: Village Link Co. Ltd with Alliance Bioversity-CIAT, IRRI (CGIAR)
farmers: 5,000 rice farmers (2023 pilot, S230); 139,000 farmers across 10 commodities (2025, S298)
outcomes: Treatment vs control areas (n=484): yields 3.77 vs 3.13 t/ha (+20.4%), net income US$237 vs US$57/ha; BCR reported 155:1 (S262, S259)
barriers: Evaluation is non-randomised comparison of exposed vs not-yet-exposed areas and implementer-affiliated - effects likely overstated (analyst note)

name: SMS and lead-farmer digital extension (fall armyworm RCT)
outcomes: Both direct SMS and hybrid lead-farmer SMS designs were evaluated for knowledge and behaviour (S274)
barriers: Low trust in outside information during conflict (S274)

name: Weather / flood index insurance for rice
farmers: 317 farmers in a discrete choice experiment (S153)
outcomes: Farmers prefer packages covering cyclone, flood and drought over salt damage (S153); Optimum rainfall-index flood contract derived (S156)
barriers: Formal finance contracted after 2021 (S286); Basis risk untested with yield data

name: Subsidised seasonal rice credit (MADB)
outcomes: Little evidence of yield/output effects; some positive household income effects (S082)
barriers: Formal credit contracted sharply in conflict areas after 2021 (S286)

name: Water users' associations in pump irrigation schemes
organization: IWMI (WLE) with LIFT funding; Welthungerhilfe; ICRISAT
outcomes: Farmers reported doubling irrigated area 1.5 years after project end despite drought (S133)
barriers: Self-reported outcomes; no counterfactual (analyst note)

name: Large dam and canal irrigation schemes
outcomes: Double cropping and income gains after Swar dam (S059); Improved VI in Thapanzeik district 2001-2020 but some canals water-limited (S214)
barriers: Delivery shortfalls in parts of command areas (S214)

name: Flatbed dryers and downdraft rice-husk furnaces
farmers: No Myanmar unit count reported; technology transferred to private companies in the Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Myanmar and Cambodia, with ~200, ~40 and 'several' units in use in the Philippines, Indonesia and Cambodia (S106)
outcomes: Flatbed dryer best on cost-benefit, labour and energy (S070)
barriers: Investment cost; no Myanmar adoption numbers

name: System of Rice Intensification via Farmer Field Schools (northern Myanmar)
outcomes: FFS study-field SRI yields 6.4 t/ha vs farmers' prior 2.1 t/ha (S008)
barriers: Before-after comparison; SRI yield advantages over best management are contested in the wider literature (S306)

name: Hybrid rice extension (Palethwe/Pearl Thwe)
location: Nay Pyi Taw and other areas
outcomes: Benefit-cost assessment of extension methods (S101)
barriers: Very limited sown area (S101); Market acceptance by paddy collectors studied in S111 (findings not extracted in this build)

name: Paw San premium variety cultivation
outcomes: Cost-return comparisons vs non-Paw San rice (S039, S049)
barriers: Not quantified

name: Quality seed systems: early-generation seed farms and contract seed production
organization: DoA seed farms; private seed companies; Wageningen CDI (ISSD)
outcomes: Townships hosting EGS seed/research farms mitigated shock-induced declines in off-farm seed use (S299)
barriers: Conflict and weather shocks disrupt seed acquisition (S299)

name: Alternate wetting and drying (AWD)
outcomes: GHG and water productivity measured in split-plot experiments (S127)
barriers: Bangladesh RCT shows farmer benefits only under volumetric water pricing (S128)

name: Rice-fish co-culture
outcomes: Ecosystem service valuation (S257); socio-economic analysis (S188)
barriers: Not quantified

name: Ecologically-based rodent management (synchronous planting, sanitation)
outcomes: Recommended synchronous planting and similar-maturity varieties after major weather events (S022)
barriers: No adoption evidence found

name: Climate-smart villages and CSA investment framework
outcomes: Cost-benefit analysis of a climate-smart village (S171); Framework for CSA policies and investments (S109)
barriers: Not quantified

name: Myanmar Rice Sector Development Strategy (MRSDS, 2015)
outcomes: Strategy launched with IRRI involvement (S307)
barriers: Implementation after 2021 Not independently verified

name: Geospatial flood/land-water maps for Department of Agriculture
outcomes: Pre-final maps discussed at all DoA levels prior to adoption for the 2020 monsoon (S093)
barriers: Adoption after 2020 Not independently verified

name: Satellite + AI rice yield monitoring (SERVIR-Mekong)
outcomes: Research prototype; limited by reference-data quality and regional-only official statistics (S251)
barriers: Ground-truth scarcity

name: Farmer Field School ICM curricula (FAO, Central Dry Zone)
outcomes: Handbooks and curricula published (S177, S173)
barriers: No outcome evaluation found
